maddeler.e:
انبثقت (form VII)
# اِنْبَثَقْتُ (inbaṯaqtu) /in.ba.θaq.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْبَثَقَ (inbaṯaqa)
# اِنْبَثَقْتَ (inbaṯaqta) /in.ba.θaq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْبَثَقَ (inbaṯaqa)
# اِنْبَثَقْتِ (inbaṯaqti) /in.ba.θaq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْبَثَقَ (inbaṯaqa)
# اِنْبَثَقَتْ (inbaṯaqat) /in.ba.θa.qat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
